model_params.features: per-window time-domain statistics of the vibration_1 channel (64 kHz) — same 10 features as the wave-4 artificial-damage run

split.protocol: MEASUREMENT-GROUPED split: GroupShuffleSplit by source_file (measurement id), 80/20, seed 42 — identical protocol to wave 4; the ONLY change vs wave 4 is the bearing set (real fatigue damage instead of artificial EDM damage). NOTE: one physical bearing per class, so train and test share bearings (different measurements of them).

preprocessing.windowing: non-overlapping windows of 2048 samples over the vibration_1 channel of each 4 s measurement

bearings.label: InnerRace
bearings.damage_origin: real (fatigue pitting, lifetime test; secondary OR indentations documented)

notes: Caveat (binding): one physical bearing per class (K001 healthy, KA04 outer-race REAL fatigue pitting, KI04 inner-race REAL fatigue pitting as its primary damage). The measurement-grouped split removes window-level leakage, but the score measures within-bearing separability across measurements and operating conditions — NOT generalisation to unseen bearings, and NOT an artificial-vs-real damage comparison (different bearings, not the same bearing before/after). KI04's official profile documents a SECONDARY outer-race damage (particle-caused indentations) alongside its primary inner-race pitting; it is recorded in extra.bearing_documentation, not hidden. CC BY-NC 4.0 data: non-commercial use only. real test-rig recordings; damage origin per bearing as listed in `bearings` (artificial EDM-seeded for KA01/KI01; real fatigue pitting from lifetime tests for KA04/KI04, per the official damage-profile PDFs shipped in each archive)

extra.documentation_source: official per-bearing damage-profile PDF shipped inside each official .rar archive (e.g. KA04/KA04.pdf), 'Profile of rolling bearing damage', Dipl.-Ing. Christian Lessmeier, Chair of Design and Drive Technology, Paderborn University — fields copied verbatim, read 2026-11-15

documented_damage.cause_of_damage: operating conditions and lubricant (overload, wrong viscosity, contamination)

bearing_documentation.label: InnerRace
bearing_documentation.damage_origin: real (fatigue pitting, accelerated lifetime test; primary damage)

documented_damage.classification_note: the bearing is categorised by its primary damage (inner-race fatigue pitting); the secondary outer-race indentations are part of its official profile and are stated here, not hidden

comparison_wave4_artificial.note: wave-4 run on the ARTIFICIAL EDM bearings (KA01/KI01) under the identical protocol; shown for context only — different physical bearings, so this is not a controlled artificial-vs-real comparison
